style: Say smoothly and warmly, like an audiobook narrator
lines: Welcome to the booth. Pick a line, then tap Record and say it in your usual voice.
Now tap a character card. Tap Record and say the same line as that character.
Tap Compare to see what you changed.
That's your usual voice. Every other take is compared to this one.
I didn't hear the words. Move closer to the mic and try again.
No microphone here. That's OK. Tap Go to Plan and perform for a partner.
Tap Record and say the line in your usual voice. Then tap Record again and change only the
You changed just that one thing. That's a fair test.
You changed more than one thing. Try again and keep the others the same.
That dial stayed about the same. Tap Record and try changing it again.
Pick Take A and Take B. Then tap Play A then B and listen for what changed.
You need two takes to compare. Tap Booth and record another.
Listener, tap a take, then tap the card you think it was. Then tap Reveal.
Slide the four dials to plan a voice. Then tap Perform it and say it for a partner.
Ask your partner to look away. Say the line using your four planned choices, then ask them to guess the card.
All takes are cleared. Tap Record to start again.
I found it! It was under the bed.
Please, may I have one more?
This is the best day ever.
I am not going to bed.
My usual voice. Just talk like you, to a friend.
Tiny mouse. Make yourself small. Quick little hands.
Sleepy giant. Stand tall and heavy. Yawn first.
Robot. Stiff arms. Every word the same.
Grumpy queen. Chin up. Arms folded.
Nervous knight. Shaky knees. Look over your shoulder.
Excited puppy. Bounce on your toes.
Old wizard. Lean on a pretend staff. Take your time.
Happy. Smile while you say it.
This first take is the baseline. Record My usual voice to compare with your everyday voice.
Tap a line, then tap Keep this line.
